name: cc-sensei
description: Distills Claude Code's 310K-line source into 32 queryable architecture modules via MCP. 6 tools for querying design decisions, reusable patterns, cross-cutting concerns, and source code.

tools.name: list_modules
tools.description: List all 32 modules and their architectural concerns

tools.name: query_architecture
tools.description: Natural-language search across all modules with 3 depth levels (brief/standard/detailed)

tools.name: get_module
tools.description: Drill into one module's specific section (responsibility, architecture, decisions, principles, relations)

tools.name: trace_concern
tools.description: Trace one concern across all 32 modules, ranked by hit count

tools.name: search_patterns
tools.description: Bulk-extract reusable design patterns with built-in size limiting

tools.name: get_source_code
tools.description: Read Claude Code source files directly with line numbers, ranges, and directory listings
